g.title: #1 InductorSeparatedFromChipPins <InductorSeparatedFromChipPins hostComponentName="U2" inductorName="L1" maxPinDistance="4.224" maxRecommendedPinDistance="3" message="Place L1 beside its two connected pins on the right side of U2 so the connections can be read together. Preserve pin connections, leave room for labels, and reroute affected traces; exact alignment is not required." />

#1 InductorSeparatedFromChipPins <InductorSeparatedFromChipPins hostComponentName="U2" inductorName="L1" maxPinDistance="4.224" maxRecommendedPinDistance="3" message="Place L1 beside its two connected pins on the right side of U2 so the connections can be read together. Preserve pin connections, leave room for labels, and reroute affected traces; exact alignment is not required." />

#2 ResistorDividerSeparatedFromChip <ResistorDividerSeparatedFromChip hostComponentName="U2" supplyResistorName="R5" groundResistorName="R6" message="Place the divider R5 / R6 beside its connected pin on the left side of U2. Both resistors are beyond the opposite chip edge. Keep supply above ground and make the tap connection direct, preserving values, symbols and all pin connections. Leave room for labels and reroute affected traces." />
